title: Evaluating statements about negative real numbers
subject: Mathematics
caption: Flowchart evaluating the truth of four statements about a negative real number x and a natural exponent k based on the parity of k.
altText: A flowchart starts with the premise that x is negative and k is a natural number. It branches on whether k is odd or even. For odd k, statements "x^k < 0" and "x·k < 0" lead to a True node, indicating they are correct, while the other two statements are false. For even k, statements "x^k > 0" and "x·k > 0" lead to a True node, indicating they are correct, while the remaining statements are false. The diagram highlights which statements are incorrect for each parity case.
